d: Long, straight platinum white hair with blunt-cut bangs and a sleek texture. Pale blue eyes with a neutral, vacant expression. An adolescent appearance with a slender build. A long-sleeved dark purple and black layered tunic with a white collar, gold button detailing, and a matching dark blue cloak with gold geometric patterns on the interior lining, paired with black stockings and black pointed heels. A red flame flickering above the shoulder and a long, wavy red blade with a black hilt.
